Acceptance criterion: Tests fail before a write if destination is outside the temporary project; no default real-project CLI calls.
Every observation has source type, author, specimen/run IDs, recorded time and revision.
Missing lighting/nozzle/time/grade remains null or unknown; no diagnostic or clean defaults.
AI cannot save an interpretation into an owner-observation field.
Counts alone cannot promote a claim; contradictory or mismatched evidence requires review.
Dispatch and telemetry cannot modify a frozen archive; any changed bytes create a different artifact.

Requirement: Approval scoped to digest and exceptions
Acceptance criterion: New build, criteria revision or unresolved hard block invalidates eligibility; only explicitly listed exceptions are covered.
Crash/retry at every boundary produces one logical mutation and the same receipt.
No prefilled clean/yes outcome; incomplete answers are rejected with field-specific messages.
Imported prospective experiments retain both origin=imported and planning=prospective.
Current run displays its build/configuration rather than the experiment's newest build.
A requested factor has declared capability evidence and measurable realized delta or fails check.
Every test states preserved conditions, changes, answerable question and transfer limits.
Exact bytes, content-equivalent, owner-confirmed and unknown are distinct statuses.
Completion never follows only from elapsed estimate; starting sender never starts a run.
Minutes and grams each have value/unit/source/precision; one manual quantity does not relabel the other.
Observed, estimated terminal, reserved and proposed amounts are separately shown and summed once.
Store UTC offset/instant and display local zone; occurred_at may be unknown independently of recorded_at.
Every grade/photo references a physical specimen or explicitly says unidentified.
Face, separation, damage, mounting and overall decision can disagree without overwriting each other.
Old values retained, new revision points to predecessor, reason and affected claims visible.
Conflicting summaries remain visible until linked original evidence supports a resolution.
Reproducible recipe includes geometry, resolved settings, sliced bytes, tool versions and scope.
Import + reference slice comparison passes before export is labelled validated.
Failed upload or stale revision preserves user's draft and already-uploaded attachments.
Pending/applied/rejected/conflict displayed with authoritative receipt and last worker heartbeat.
CLI and UI consume the same domain projection and meaning of every total/state.
Distinguish budget, owner stop, integrity block and review-needed; useful failures are not automatically worthless.
Keyboard paths, focus restoration, semantic inputs, labels, errors, contrast and reduced motion pass the validation matrix.
Restore records, original photos, artifacts and receipts into an isolated project and verify hashes.
Planner searches structure/material/nozzle/layout/purpose and shows similarity limitations.
Executable rule evaluated against labelled positive and negative cases; coverage is not called precision.
Report usable yield and total labor/material per accepted tile with uncertainty.
Missing camera or cloud-only control does not block manual observation workflows.
